Warrican’s Five‑Wicket Haul Powers West Indies to Dominant Position on Day 2 of Bangladesh Test

West Indies seize control in Mirpur

The second day of the opening ICC World Test Championship match between Bangladesh and the West Indies saw a dramatic shift in momentum after the hosts collapsed from 213/3 to 272 all out. Left‑arm spinner Jomel Warrican finished with 5/53, the best figures of the innings, while debutant Joshua Bishop added two wickets, including the crucial dismissal of Shadman Islam (105).

Bangladesh innings – 272 all out

  • Fall of wickets: 213/3 → 272 all out (last seven wickets for 59 runs)
  • Key dismissals:
  • Shadman Islam (105) – bowled by Bishop
  • Towhid Hridoy – returned after retiring hurt, out to Bishop on his second ball
  • Mehidy Hasan Miraz – bowled by Warrican
  • Nayeem Hasan & Hasan Mahmud – taken by Shamar Joseph
  • Taijul Islam & Shoriful Islam – consecutive wickets by Warrican
  • Bowling figures: Warrican 5/53 (seven wickets shared with Bishop)

The source confirms the collapse and the wicket‑taking partnership of Warrican and Bishop, but does not provide any direct quotes from players or coaches.

West Indies reply – 134/4 at stumps

  • Opening partnership: John Campbell and Tagenarine Chanderpaul added 61 runs for the second wicket.
  • Key moments:
  • Campbell edged a delivery from Hasan Mahmud, caught by substitute keeper Jaker Ali.
  • After a rain break, Mehidy Hasan Miraz dismissed Campbell.
  • Taijul Islam struck twice in one over, removing Kavem Hodge and Amir Jangoo, reducing West Indies from 90/1 to 97/4.
  • Chanderpaul (43* with six fours) and Justin Greaves (15*) steadied the innings with an unbeaten 37‑run stand.
  • Score at close: West Indies 134/4, trailing by 138 runs with six wickets in hand.

The match was halted early due to rain and bad light, as reported by the ICC.

Practical implications

  • Series outlook: With Bangladesh’s first‑innings lead erased, the West Indies are well‑placed to take a lead in the Test, potentially influencing the ICC World Test Championship points table.
  • Player impact:
  • Warrican’s five‑for could boost his selection prospects for the remainder of the series.
  • Bishop’s debut performance may earn him a regular spot in the spin attack.
  • Verification: The official ICC match report (URL provided) contains the full scorecard and can be cross‑checked on the ICC website’s live‑scores page for the Bangladesh vs West Indies – 1st Test (28 Oct – 1 Nov, Mirpur, Bangladesh Standard Time).

What remains unknown

  • The final result of the Test, as the match is still in progress.
  • Any injuries or team changes that may occur after Day 2.
  • The exact impact of the weather interruption on the remaining playing time.
